newsitem.title: SURINAM: Surinam finance chief says drastic steps needed.
newsitem.headline: Surinam finance chief says drastic steps needed.

text.p: Surinam's new Finance Minister Atta Mungra warned Wednesday that the government would need to take drastic steps to balance its budget.

According to Mungra, who was named Finance Minister by President Jules Wijdenbosch last month, said 44 percent of total spending is absorbed on footing wages for the 40,000-strong public sector workforce.
Mungra said the government's wages bill must be slashed to 25 percent of total spending and subsidies cut from 30 percent to no more than 10 percent of the budget within two years.
He did not give the size of the government's budget.

Since taking power in early September Wijdenbosch's government has embarked on a 100-day program which has included an aggressive road repairing campaign and efforts made to clean up the capital Paramaribo.
